about: Union Station track deck extent in the union_station landmark frame (landmarks.json pos / rotation; local x east along Front St, local y north). The rail LEVEL is not set here: it is the network model's (curated/corridors.json 'usrc', applied by tpipe.roadnet; docs/ROADS.md 'Source of truth'). tpipe.landmarks writes the model's rail z on the deck into landmarks.json union_station.rail_z (and the track centrelines), which the landmark deck and platforms use; platforms are rail_z + 0.9. tpipe.stations checks the train graph against the model on this extent.

up_deck.note: UP Express platform 1A on the north track west of York St, also at rail_z
